name: – Konstantinos Arvanitis – After § 86 – Am 4
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2025 Rule of Law report
part_text: 86a. Expresses deep concern about evidence and reports suggesting that certain civil society organisations have engaged in illegal actions, including aiding and abetting illegal migration and cooperating with human smuggling networks; underlines the fact that NGOs that systematically violate national and international law pose a serious threat to the rule of law and must be held accountable through effective enforcement mechanisms;
